title: Chapter 274 Fellow Daoist Helps Me Kill This Dog
content:
Chapter 274 Fellow Daoist Helps Me Kill This Dog

But under the killing intent of everyone, Li Cheng couldn't help but clenched the bloody long sword even more tightly with his right hand. There seemed to be infinite power gushing out from the long sword, and as his hands flowed to his limbs, he felt a kind of world A wonderful sense of place in his hands.

"It's such a wonderful feeling. I seem to have the power to sweep the world at this moment!" Li Cheng looked crazy, with a ferocious look on his face, his whole body was surrounded by the blood mist of the blood sword, and countless ghost faces appeared all over his body. Like a devil crawling out of hell.

The complexions of the gangsters who watched Li Cheng and surrounded him tightly changed. This kind of momentum, this strange scene, is really frightening.

What is even more frightening is Li Cheng's cultivation.

They saw with their own eyes that Li Cheng was only at the first-class early stage cultivation base, but after the blood mist from the blood sword lingered all over his body, he continued to climb, directly broke through the first-class early stage, middle stage, and directly reached the late stage cultivation base, and it seemed that he would continue to break through , reaching the unattainable peak.

"Damn it, it can't go on like this anymore, if you continue to let it go, it's hard to stop this greed!" The person who spoke was Chiba, the head of the Qianye Sword Sect.

As the most famous Jianghu sect in Jiujiang County of Chu State, Chiba swordsmanship is the best in Jiujiang, and his reputation has spread to several counties around him, and he is extremely famous in Chu State.

This time, the bait thrown by the Yu Kingdom attracted Qianye from thousands of miles to the south, and they fought desperately.

After one month, there were only a few hundred of the three hundred disciples that Qianye originally had with him, and most of them were wounded, so the casualties could be said to be extremely heavy.

Now he is all counting on getting this sword in exchange for a county fief to restore his reputation.

Otherwise, among the three hundred disciples who died, there were quite a few noble children from Jiujiang County. They originally entrusted their children to him, but they just wanted to use his influence and let them learn all kinds of skills.

Now that the momentum has declined, and the disciples who have acquired the ability have died, how could those dignitaries in Jiujiang County let Qianye go?

The reason why Qian Yezi had this reputation before is that his sect has been passed down for a long time, and it has been more than two hundred years now, and many secret methods have been passed down in the sect, which is much more profound than many aristocratic families in Jiujiang County.

Qianye is also due to your extraordinary birth, your Qianye sect's many skills, you have gained a great reputation in Chu State, and you are the number one master in Jiujiang, so you are admired by many dignitaries.

But now, he has made such a major mistake, and those powerful people will not let him go.

Although he is a first-class mid-term master, his strength is the best in the entire Jiujiang County, but Jiujiang is not without first-class masters. Don't say anything else, let's just talk about the masters enshrined in each family, among them there are seven or eight first-class, even if their strength is not as good as him, but if they are united, he alone can't resist it.

So now, in the desperate situation he was facing, even if he felt that Li Cheng's strength had soared to the point where he could not stop him, he still had to bite the bullet and win that chance of life.

In fact, it wasn't just Qianye, many other people present were like him, this time for this blood sword, for the reward of the blood sword, they gave everything, and many people's family money was wiped out.

If they can't win and get the blood sword in the end, then their fate will not be much better.

"Qianye Luoyu!" Qianye yelled, and directly used his most powerful move, which is also the signature of Qianyemen.

The most powerful part of this trick is that after it is used, the powerful internal force can be transformed into thousands of green leaves, each piece is as sharp as a sword's edge, making people have nowhere to look and nowhere to hide.

After Qianye used it in front of him, there was green within ten meters around him, and thousands of leaf blades circled and danced continuously, bringing out gusts of wind.

Li Cheng's face turned serious, obviously the pressure Qianye put on him in front of him was not small, even though his strength had suddenly burst into the late stage, but it was not his original strength after all, and it was a bit rusty to pick up.

Swinging the blood sword in his hand, streams of mist swirled, colliding with the green leaves formed by the inner force and disappearing continuously.

After a few breaths, there were not many blades left, but Li Cheng's aura became more terrifying, and the surrounding air was slightly distorted by his aura.

However, although Li Cheng's aura became more and more terrifying, his movements suddenly stagnated slightly. A flaw inevitably appeared in the originally smooth offensive.

"Great opportunity!" Qianye Zi's eyes lit up, realizing that this was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, and she might have the chance to defeat Li Cheng.

He saw his palm moving slightly, and the green leaves followed his will, attacking Li Cheng directly, but secretly, there were three most powerful leaves gathered, waiting for the opportunity to attack at the opening.

Li Cheng looked at the hundreds of leaf blades rushing towards him in front of him, his heart trembled, he didn't dare to neglect, he hurriedly mobilized the blood mist, and moved towards the leaf blade to stop him.

Soon, although Ye Ren's offensive was ferocious and extremely powerful, every move carried infinite power. But after all, it was not as good as the blood mist brought by the blood sword. It was quickly eroded by the blood mist and turned into a puff of green smoke, which drifted away with the wind.

However, what Li Cheng didn't notice was that at the dead center of his vision, there were three leaves quietly coming to him, and attacking his vitals swiftly and fiercely.

Chi Chi Chi!

The sound of three blades piercing into the flesh sounded, causing Li Cheng to scream. The attack, which was originally extremely smooth, stopped, and the blood mist surged and rolled, as if it was about to dissipate.

"Damn, hate, you humble ants, dare to hurt me? Unforgivable, unforgivable!" Li Cheng wailed for a while, and then his face became more ferocious, and the internal energy of his whole body was continuously injected into the blood sword, making The originally precarious blood mist became stable again and spread even more frighteningly.

Within 50 meters around, it was covered by the spreading blood mist, and it was difficult to see five steps away. The eyes were blood red, and the pungent and unpleasant smell of blood caused everyone to frown and vomit.

"Fellow daoists, Li Cheng has been wounded by me, and it is bound to be difficult for a long time. Why don't you join me in attacking? Kill this beast and take back the long sword!" Qian Yezi yelled loudly, with a look of panic on his face, and hurriedly called for help people help.

The attack just now was done with all his strength, and after using it, 80% of his internal energy has been consumed. With the previous consumption, now only 10% of his internal energy is left in his body, which is already unsustainable.

Facing Li Cheng's death eruption at this moment, seeing that the power is more violent and unstoppable than before, how can he not make him panic.

I couldn't help calling out to everyone to resist.

The people around who were standing by and watching originally wanted Chiba to test Li Cheng's strength, but they didn't want Li Cheng to be so terrifying. Ye Zi's first-class mid-stage cultivation before was hard to stop, and he fell into a disadvantage.
